verses.text: This is the family line of Esau, who is also called Edom.
Esau married women from among the Canaanites: Adah, the daughter of Elon the Hittite, and Oholibamah, the daughter of Anah and granddaughter of Zibeon the Hivite.
He also married Basemath, Ishmael's daughter and the sister of Nebaioth.
Adah gave Esau a son named Eliphaz, and Basemath had Reuel.
Oholibamah had Jeush, Jalam and Korah. These were the sons of Esau, who were born to him in the land of Canaan.

Esau took his wives, his sons and daughters and all the members of his household, as well as his livestock and all his other animals and all the goods he had gained in Canaan. He moved to a land some distance away from his brother Jacob.
They owned too much to stay together. The land where they were living could not support them both, because they had so much livestock.
So Esau, who is also called Edom, settled in the hill country of Seir.
This is the family line of Esau, the ancestor of the Edomites, in the hill country of Seir.
These are the names of Esau's sons: Eliphaz, the son of Esau's wife Adah, and Reuel, the son of Esau's wife Basemath.
The sons of Eliphaz were Teman, Omar, Zepho, Gatam and Kenaz.
Esau's son Eliphaz also had a secondary wife named Timna, and she gave birth to Amalek. These were the grandsons of Esau's wife Adah.
The sons of Reuel were Nahath, Zerah, Shammah and Mizzah. These were the grandsons of Esau's wife Basemath.
The sons of Esau's wife Oholibamah, the daughter of Anah and granddaughter of Zibeon, whom she gave to Esau, were Jeush, Jalam and Korah.
These were the clan leaders among Esau's descendants. The sons of Eliphaz, Esau's firstborn, were the leaders Teman, Omar, Zepho, Kenaz,
Korah, Gatam and Amalek. These were the leaders who came from Eliphaz in Edom. They were grandsons of Adah.
The sons of Esau's son Reuel were the leaders Nahath, Zerah, Shammah and Mizzah. These were the leaders who came from Reuel in Edom. They were grandsons of Esau's wife Basemath.
The sons of Esau's wife Oholibamah were the leaders Jeush, Jalam and Korah. These were the leaders who came from Esau's wife Oholibamah, the daughter of Anah.
These were the sons of Esau, who is Edom, and these were their leaders.
These were the sons of Seir the Horite, who were living in the land: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah,
Dishon, Ezer and Dishan. These sons of Seir in Edom were the Horite leaders.
The sons of Lotan were Hori and Homam. Timna was Lotan's sister.
The sons of Shobal were Alvan, Manahath, Ebal, Shepho and Onam.
The sons of Zibeon were Aiah and Anah. This is the Anah who found the hot springs in the desert while he was looking after the donkeys of his father Zibeon.
The children of Anah were Dishon and Oholibamah, the daughter of Anah.
The sons of Dishon were Hemdan, Eshban, Ithran and Keran.
The sons of Ezer were Bilhan, Zaavan and Akan.
The sons of Dishan were Uz and Aran.
These were the Horite leaders: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah,
Dishon, Ezer and Dishan. These were the Horite leaders, listed by their clans in the land of Seir.
These were the kings who ruled in Edom before any king ruled over the Israelites:
Bela son of Beor became king of Edom. His city was named Dinhabah.
When Bela died, Jobab son of Zerah from Bozrah became king after him.
When Jobab died, Husham from the land of the Temanites became king after him.
When Husham died, Hadad son of Bedad became king after him. Hadad was the one who defeated Midian in the country of Moab. His city was named Avith.
When Hadad died, Samlah from Masrekah became king after him.
When Samlah died, Shaul from Rehoboth on the river became king after him.
When Shaul died, Baal-Hanan son of Akbor became king after him.
When Baal-Hanan son of Akbor died, Hadar became king after him. His city was named Pau, and his wife's name was Mehetabel. She was the daughter of Matred and the granddaughter of Me-Zahab.
These were the leaders who came from Esau, listed by their clans and their places, by name: Timna, Alvah, Jetheth,
Oholibamah, Elah, Pinon,
Kenaz, Teman, Mibzar,
Magdiel and Iram. These were the leaders of Edom, listed by where they lived in the land they owned. This is the family line of Esau, the ancestor of the Edomites.
